## Breadcrumbs.svelte

### `interface Props`

- `items` :: The trail, in order from the root to the current page.
- `separator` :: The icon drawn between crumbs.
- `maxItems` :: When the trail is longer than this, collapse the middle behind an ellipsis.
- `label` :: Accessible name of the navigation.
- `size` :: The height of the ellipsis button that expands a collapsed trail.
- `shape` :: The corner treatment of that ellipsis button.
- `textSize` :: The scale of the crumb labels and of the ellipsis glyph.
- `textColor` :: The ink of the separator icon between crumbs.

## items.ts

### `interface BreadcrumbItem`

One crumb in a Breadcrumbs trail. The last item is the current page.

- `label` :: The visible label.
- `href` :: A destination. Omit it on the current page, or on a crumb that is not a link.
- `icon` :: An icon drawn before the label.
